name: pgvector
summary: pgvector is an open-source Postgres extension that adds vector column types and similarity search, so embeddings live in the same tables as the rest of the data. It supports exact search and approximate search through HNSW and IVFFlat indexes, and can be combined with Postgres full-text search for hybrid queries.
facts: Postgres tables (vector, halfvec, bit, sparsevec types)
L2, inner product, cosine, L1, Hamming, Jaccard
vector up to 2,000 dims; halfvec up to 4,000
Self-hosted or preinstalled on many hosted Postgres providers
goodFor: Joining vectors with relational data and filters
watchOut: Indexed vector columns are capped at 2,000 dimensions (halfvec 4,000)
HNSW builds are memory-hungry and slow on large tables
Several 2026 patch releases fix index build and vacuum bugs; stay current
